claim_boundaries: The Gemma 4 report discloses thinking mode and its BBEH score, but not the BBEH output-token ceiling, seed, sample count, or complete internal harness.

The full 4520-row base run is the only cell compared directly with the paper; adapter claims use only frozen index>=50 rows.
This profile is separate from and does not replace the preregistered greedy non-thinking RL evaluation.
